description: Email a link to a review to the person who ran the study. Sends only to an address that belongs to a verified Cobalt account (other addresses are refused, which keeps the tool from being used to send unsolicited mail). The email contains only the review link, never text supplied in the call.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (proves you created this review), or, for a saved review, the agent token its owner generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent).

email.description: The human's Cobalt account email. Must belong to a verified account, or the send is refused.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

name: email_review
